connector.name: Pane
connector.registryDescription: Hand a human a rich interactive UI by URL and get structured data back, from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aerolalit account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PANE_API_KEY
env.description: Pane agent API key. If unset, the server auto-registers a fresh agent against the relay on first use and saves the key to the shared CLI store (~/.config/pane/config.json).

env.name: PANE_URL
env.description: Pane relay base URL. Defaults to the hosted relay https://relay.paneui.com; set this to point at a self-hosted relay.

env.name: PANE_AGENT_NAME
env.description: Display name for the auto-registered agent on the relay.

env.name: PANE_REGISTER_SECRET
env.description: Registration secret, required only for relays running REGISTRATION_MODE=secret.
